item.title: Special Edition — Fine-Tuning Is Probability Surgery

item.title: Special Edition — America at 250: The Claim That Outran the Founders
item.description: A long-form America 250 special with Heart as the American narrator and a dry British foil, exploring what was — and was not — special about July 1776: British imperial context, colonial rights arguments, the Declaration as legal brief and moral time bomb, and the founding promise that outran the founders themselves.
